interface.title: Heatwise — Urban Heat Mitigation dashboard
interface.field: Urban climate / remote sensing / municipal planning (urban heat island mitigation)
interface.stage_of_work: Exploring the analysis and supporting decisions: reviewing a precomputed satellite-derived thermal grid and a budget-ranked list of interventions, then exporting a plan report
interface.what_it_is_for: Explore a city's 100 m Landsat land-surface-temperature grid, relate it to vegetation (NDVI), and set a budget to see which cooling interventions get funded, ranked by cooling per rupee, along with the projected post-mitigation temperature surface.

data.note: The committed city grids load from the server: Guwahati (default, 8,144 cells), Ahmedabad, Chennai, New Delhi, Nagpur, Phoenix and Hyderabad (Hyderabad not opened). I also loaded the uploaded test file grid.geojson through 'Load your grid'. It turned out to be a 22,714-cell grid of Nagpur, read client-side ('Nothing was uploaded'). Downloads read: guwahati-grid.geojson (per-cell temperature, ndvi, ndbi, land_cover, priority, recommended_action, cost_estimate, cooling_c, plan_rank) and delhi-ranking.csv (rank, LST, NDVI, action, cost, cooling_per_rupee, cumulative_cost, within_budget).

screens_never_reached: Hyderabad city view: listed in the City picker but not opened, because of the action limit
Location search results: the search box opened (screens/035.webp) but I did not submit a query, because it calls nominatim.openstreetmap.org, which is off-limits
Street View / Google Maps 'Verify on the ground' targets: these are external links
A cell whose recommended action is 'None' with an exclusion reason (e.g. water or existing tree cover): my clicks did not land on one, though such cells exist in the downloaded GeoJSON
not_done: Re-enabling a measure after unchecking it. Once Cool Roof is unchecked, its checkbox disappears and the row reads 'Not proposed in this study area.' Clicking the row does not bring it back (screens/026.webp, screens/027.webp). The exclusion also carried over to Nagpur and to the loaded file until the page was reloaded (screens/023.webp, screens/029.webp).

Because of that, the Guwahati screens from screens/007.webp to screens/030.webp (the cell panel, the analytics histogram and the loaded-grid budget) were captured with Cool Roof excluded rather than with the default plan.
Drag-and-drop loading of grid.geojson: the browser cannot drag files in, so I used the 'Load your grid' file picker instead.
Location search (nominatim geocoder): not used, as it is an external service.
The About panel was not checked for staleness: after switching to Nagpur it still described '8,144 cells over the Guwahati study area' (screens/023.webp).
After Clear area, the dashed outline of the previous selection box stayed on the map, although the stats returned to the whole study area (screens/050.webp, screens/053.webp).
Clicking a scatter point in the NDVI chart does not select or highlight that cell on the map, so the chart and map are not linked at the item level (screens/043.webp).
dataset.csv and city.json from the Delhi Data menu were not downloaded or read. Only ranking.csv and guwahati-grid.geojson were.

The post-mitigation difference in the swipe view is subtle. Most interventions cool by 1–2 °C, so the before/after colour change is only clearly visible at higher budgets in a selected area (screens/047.webp, screens/048.webp).

Two interactions failed with locator timeouts and left no kept screen: a sidebar click right after the ₹100 Cr preset, and a first divider drag on the loaded grid (the retry succeeded, screens/034.webp).
